changes.title: Ibex bounds
items: Between their charges, ibex now bound back uphill in two staggered lines where you can see them, instead of vanishing into the trees

changes.title: No teleport
items: Animals no longer teleport in a fight: ones that slip into the trees, underground or into the water between attacks (the ibex, squirrels, moles, otters) come back where they've actually got to, and a leap interrupted mid-air carries on its arc

changes.title: Lone shooters
items: Animals fighting on their own now use their own attack: a lone fox, marten or dormouse shoots its bolts, a squirrel lobs, instead of only biting
